ordering: deterministic ABBA per block: reference, candidate, candidate, reference; same fixture and stream
primary_estimator: arithmetic mean latency per implementation/config; geometric mean of per-config speedups only after both stability gates
raw_data: retain every valid sample; no silent outlier deletion

uncertainty.method: paired bootstrap CI95 over ABBA block speedups

environment: read-only GPU/process provenance captured per invocation; no clock/process changes
